control_name: ACORD transaction envelopes are well-formed and conformant
control_objective: Every ACORD transaction exchanged over the integration platform is wrapped in a well-formed, conformant ACORD transaction envelope, so that routing, correlation, and acknowledgement metadata are reliably interpreted by partner endpoints.
risk_addressed: Malformed or non-conformant transaction envelopes break message routing, correlation, and acknowledgement handling, causing lost or duplicated transactions, failed acknowledgements, and orphaned in-flight policy changes.

required_data_elements.business_definition: The ACORD transaction envelope wrapping a message, including header, control, and acknowledgement metadata.

method.summary: Inspect a sampled population of ACORD transaction envelopes for well-formedness and conformance to the ACORD envelope structure and count any conformance failures.
steps: Sample ACORD transactions from the integration bus over the assessment period.
Parse each transaction envelope and check well-formedness.
Validate the envelope structure against the ACORD transaction envelope definition.
method.sampling_rule: Sample all transactions where volume permits; otherwise a representative sample across transaction types.
method.fallback_logic: If the bus is unavailable, mark Not Run and raise a Missing Source item rather than passing.

thresholds.materiality_basis: Any envelope that fails the ACORD envelope structure is a conformance exception.

pass_criteria: All sampled transaction envelopes conform to the ACORD envelope structure.
fail_criteria: One or more sampled transaction envelopes fail conformance.
exception_handling: Quarantine the offending transaction flow and re-test before resuming.

assertions.description: All transaction envelopes conform to the ACORD envelope structure.

downstream_linkage.staleness_rule: Must be re-evidenced each assessment cycle.

actions_on_fail: Notify Integration Architect and Chief Architect
